description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for various RNN modules (RNN, LSTM, GRU) and their cells in PyTorch's C++ API, including base classes, options, and module holders.

classes.name: RNNImplBase
classes.description: Base class template for RNN implementations, providing common functionality such as parameter management, device transfer, and options handling.

classes.name: RNNImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a multi-layer Elman RNN with configurable nonlinearity.

classes.name: LSTMImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a multi-layer LSTM module.

classes.name: GRUImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a multi-layer GRU module.

classes.name: RNNCellImplBase
classes.description: Base class template for RNN cell implementations, managing weights and input checks.

classes.name: RNNCellImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an Elman RNN cell with configurable nonlinearity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Initializes or resets the parameters of the RNN module.

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Resets the parameters of the RNN module.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Transfers the module to a specified device and/or data type.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Prints a human-readable description of the module.

methods.name: flatten_parameters
methods.description: Prepares internal weights for efficient computation, especially on GPU.

methods.name: all_weights
methods.description: Returns all weights of the RNN module.

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Checks the validity of input tensors.

methods.name: get_expected_hidden_size
methods.description: Calculates expected hidden state size based on input.

methods.name: check_hidden_size
methods.description: Validates the size of the hidden state tensor.

methods.name: check_forward_args
methods.description: Checks arguments for the forward pass.

methods.name: permute_hidden
methods.description: Permutes hidden state tensor according to a permutation.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the RNN or RNN cell.

methods.name: forward_with_packed_input
methods.description: Performs forward pass with packed sequence input.

methods.name: forward_helper
methods.description: Helper function for forward pass, handling batch processing.

methods.name: get_nonlinearity_str
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the nonlinearity used in RNN cell.
